endpoint.name: Create / Update Negative Keyword Settings For Campaign
endpoint.summary: Create or update negative keyword settings for a campaign
endpoint.description: Creates or updates negative keyword settings for a campaign. Each keyword entry is either a create (no id) or an update (id and status required; keyword, match_type, and bid_value forbidden). BROAD match type is not allowed for negative keywords.

parameters.name: advertiser_id
parameters.description: Osmos generated unique identifier for the onboarded advertiser.

keywords.description: List of negative-keyword operations. Must contain at least 1 item. Each item is either a create entry (no id) or an update entry (id required; keyword, match_type, and bid_value forbidden).

oneOf.title: Create Negative Keyword
oneOf.description: Use this shape to create a new negative keyword. Do not include id.

match_type.description: Allowed values: PHRASE; EXACT. BROAD is not allowed for negative keywords.

oneOf.title: Update Negative Keyword
oneOf.description: Use this shape to update an existing negative keyword. id and status are required; keyword, match_type, and bid_value are forbidden.

id.description: Negative keyword ID. Obtain this from the GET endpoint.
